title: Black Friday Video Ad Templates | AIVideosUGC
description: Make a Black Friday video ad from one product photo, with a promotion shoppers can read at a glance. Skip the camera day and post the clip today.
h1: Black Friday Templates for a Clear Promotion
eyebrow: A Sale Clip Without a Shoot
lead: Make your Black Friday promotion hard to miss, without booking a camera day.

steps.d: Upload one sharp photo of the product in the offer, with the full item visible.
Describe a warm holiday room, pick a spoken voice, and choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
Download the clip and add the price in your editor. You set the code and the end date.

faq.q: What does this Black Friday template make?
faq.a: A deal clip built from the product photo you already have. An AI avatar, a script, and a spoken voice can come with it. You add the offer after download.

faq.q: How does the sale scene come together?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe the holiday room, pick a size and a length, then add captions or the offer in the editor.

faq.q: Why skip a shoot during sale week?
faq.a: The product photo from your page is enough to build the sale scene. You can spend the week on the offer, not on a new camera day.

faq.q: Who is this Black Friday template for?
faq.a: Shops that need a product clip for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or a later holiday offer, on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or the product page.

faq.q: Can I do this with no editing practice?
faq.a: Yes. The sale scene is built from your product photo. A song from the music library can sit under the voice in the editor.
One sharp photo of the item that is actually in the offer, with the full shape visible. A short clip you have rights to can be uploaded too.

faq.q: Which size and length fit a deal post?
faq.a: Use a tall 9:16 for Stories and Reels, or a square 1:1 for the feed. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You can also use 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 when the post needs that shape.

faq.q: Does the tool write the discount?
faq.a: No. Add the live price, the code, and the end date after download. If the offer changes, edit that text instead of trusting an old file.

A clip spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. If it fails, those credits come back. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Nothing is stamped on the file, so the download can run in paid ads and on the product page.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or my own software?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product page for a script and a voice you are allowed to use. When many products share the sale setup, run them together or start the jobs from your shop software.

definition.title: A Sale Scene Without a Camera Day
